flags.message: The respondents' opposition (filed 2026-09-25, the entry that opens this response-filed event and inside the cutoff) was not provisioned under record/documents/; only the stay application was. I fetched it from the Supreme Court docket URL recorded in the snapshot entry and extracted its text locally. For a moment defined by the response arriving, provisioning the response text alongside the application would put every predictor on the same footing.
